d.ko: Pathologic 2 is a groundbreaking open-world horror RPG.  Resist the plague. Make medicine. Heal people. Perform an autopsy. Trade to get what you need. Fight and kill if necessary. Survive. Struggle with an outbreak in a secluded rural town that is rapidly turning into hell.

d.zh: 《瘟疫2》是一款创新性开放世界恐怖RPG。抵抗瘟疫，制作解药，治愈人们，进行解剖。为了得到所需而交易，为了生存而战斗和杀戮。在一个与世隔绝的乡村小镇与疫情斗争，而这个小镇正迅速沦为地狱。
